changing its status. Report missing build infrastructure as not_run/partial, never passed.

evaluation results may be consulted. The designated target oracle commit is excluded from
this workspace. Perform a fresh port based exclusively on these supplied inputs.

versions are available, with original commit SHAs, parent edges, merges and full ancestry
of the two allowed endpoints. No source-path filtering or synthetic history is used.

target-wide searches. Read target declarations, callers, Makefiles and tests as needed.

actual files before claiming build infrastructure is absent. Installed toolchains and
external/submodule dependencies still need separate verification. Do not execute large
unbounded whole-tree reads; use incremental queries and focused context.

Analysis mode: model-led. Start by reading the reference patch and pre-fix code.

choose subsequent context. Use ordinary Git/read/search tools; do not call analyze_port.py
or porter_core.analyze_port/trace_history as a precomputed locator or automatic continuation.
Handle rewrites at the current edge, retain all relevant split branches, then continue
investigating later history until the exact target. Do not jump from a resolved breakpoint
straight to declaring the whole mapping complete. Cite evidence for skipped intervals.
Maintain analysis-evidence.json with actual observations/output references and write

tool logs or semantic confirmations. trace-evidence.json is not required.

record missing_context with concrete requested evidence and stop blocked if it is needed.
Do not search outside the supplied repository or claim the missing code is not affected.
